flags.message: record/documents/questions-presented.txt extracted a slice from Part III.A of the petition ('The Questions Presented In This Case Are Exceptionally Important') rather than page (I) because page (I) of petition.txt contains a space inside the heading ('QUESTION S PRESENTED').
